competitors.name: Feel Good Foods
competitors.action: Expanded nationally at Target in April, growing from 4 to 7 SKUs and adding Pepperoni Pizza Bagels alongside broader frozen-snack distribution.

competitors.name: Amy's Kitchen
competitors.action: Its Personal Pizza was named one of Progressive Grocer's Best New Products of 2026, reinforcing demand for premium, clean-label single-serve frozen pizza.

trends.topic: Global flavor demand is moving mainstream in frozen and prepared foods
trends.magnitude: Progressive Grocer reports Gen Z and Millennials are over-indexing on international cuisines in frozen/prepared food
trends.context: This matters for frozen pizza because younger shoppers are increasingly looking for bold, differentiated flavor stories instead of plain cheese/pepperoni parity. Real Dough should treat globally inflected flavoring, heat, and sauce profiles as a growth lane, especially in limited-time or retailer-specific SKUs.

breaking.headline: Target is still adding differentiated frozen pizza-adjacent products, not just legacy brands
breaking.impact: The freezer buyer signal is clear: products with a specific nutritional or format hook can still win shelf space nationally. Real Dough needs equally sharp retail positioning, not generic premium claims.
